race.comment: LA MORRA (10) was snagged back from a wide alley then went through her gears nicely to finish fifth when resuming over 1400m here last start. Up a little in grade but drops 2kgs and is fitter for that last run. Nicely placed out to 1600m at this stage of the campaign. SNEAKY CHOICE (7) has gone around in Sydney midweekers at her last four starts and while winless she has been competitive. Has raced at Kembla four times for two wins including once at the mile. In the right race to turn things around. FIFTYFIVECHEVY (2) got going late to get up for second recently over 1400m at this circuit. Has his share of weight but 1600m is his right trip so watch for another big finish. CAP D'AIL (3) stepped up to this distance for the first time here a fortnight ago and was a shade too good in a Class 1. Meets a better field today but his stocks are still rising. SATNESS (1) owns the mile here with five wins from ten attempts, the latest two runs back under 59.5kgs. Hard to leave out.
